name: OpenCalc
summary: Calculator with scientific mode, history and light and dark themes

description.en: A lightweight calculator with scientific mode, calculation history and support for portrait and landscape layouts. Includes light, dark and Material You themes and a quick settings tile.
description.pt: Calculadora leve com modo científico, histórico de cálculos e utilização na vertical ou horizontal. Inclui temas claro, escuro e Material You, além de um atalho nas definições rápidas.
